stem.text: A uniform rod of weight $28\,\text{N}$ is supported at one end by force $F$.
The rod is in equilibrium and attached to a frictionless hinge at end X.

stem.alt: Uniform rod pivoted at end X and inclined at 40° to the horizontal, with a force F acting at its upper end, perpendicular to the rod, and a downward weight of 28 N acting on the rod.
